selection_rationale: Highest direct operational relevance to NetOps safety (pre-deployment semantic validation), clear paired design with strong feasibility and venue fit, reviewer 'pass' with concrete, addressable repair items—likely to yield actionable evidence within available compute budget.
unresolved_uncertainties: Completeness and coverage of the formal verifier (which semantic properties are/are not checked).
Representativeness of the synthetic/derived intent set versus production change requests and edge cases.
Impact of LLM nondeterminism on paired-variance and statistical power assumptions.
Precise operational definition and independent logging of the human-intervention flag (who/when/why).
Generalisability of verifier-assisted gains to large-scale, heterogeneous production verifiers and topologies.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Provide a formal, testable verifier specification listing checked properties, known limitations, and negative-control checks.
Specify human-intervention criteria and an independent logging procedure (who/when/why a case is flagged).
Broaden and document intent-set provenance and sampling; define explicit complexity strata (low/medium/high).
Publish exact prompts, seeds, retry policy, and all repair-prompt templates in the preregistration.
Run a small preregistered pilot to estimate variability and justify paired-sample power assumptions; predefine handling for LLM nondeterminism (e.g., seed/control procedures).
